'''Holalkere Rangarao Chandrasekhar''', ({{lang|kn|ಹೊಳಲ್ಕೆರೆ ರಂಗರಾವ್ ಚಂದ್ರಶೇಖರ್}})<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://web.missouri.edu/~chandrasekharh/index.html |title=H.R.Chandrasekhar' Website' |access-date=2015-08-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131009155631/http://web.missouri.edu/~chandrasekharh/index.html |archive-date=2013-10-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref> known as "Chandra",<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://physics.missouri.edu/directory/faculty/h-r-chandrasekhar/ |title=Department of physics and Astronomy, &#91;&#91;University of Missouri&#93;&#93;, Chandrasekhar |access-date=2015-08-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150605213842/http://physics.missouri.edu/directory/faculty/h-r-chandrasekhar/ |archive-date=2015-06-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref> was a professor of physics, department chair and director of graduate studies at the University of Missouri. He is an Alfred P. Sloan Fellow and a past consultant to the United Nations Development under the TOKTEN project.

==Early life==
Chandrasekhar was born at [[Holalkere]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.xombom.com/pincode/holalkere-chitradurga-pincode/55106/ |title=Holalkere |access-date=2015-08-02 |archive-date=2016-03-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305050612/http://www.xombom.com/pincode/holalkere-chitradurga-pincode/55106/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> a small hamlet in [[Chitradurga district]], [[Karnataka]] to father H. V. Rangarao <ref>[http://www.shorpy.com/node/11898 Shorpy.com. Rangarao and friends]</ref> and mother D. Radhamma.<ref>[http://www.shorpy.com/node/19928 Smt. Devanahalli Radhamma, Singer of Traditional kannada ritual songs]</ref> His father was the local auditor and the Shanubhogue of [[Chirnahalli]] and [[Kudinirkatte]]. He was a well-known astrologer.

==Honors==
* 1996-97: Visiting research scholar, department of physics, Purdue University, West Lafayette, IN 47907 (June-Dec. 1996); 
* Visiting research professor, Optical Sciences Center, University of Arizona, Tucson (Jan. -June 1997).
* 1993: Consultant to India under the Transfer of Knowledge (TOKTEN) program sponsored by the United Nations Development Program (UNDP).
* 1980-1984: Alfred P. Sloan Foundation Fellowship. One of twenty-one physicists selected in National Competition on the basis of "exceptional potential to make creative contributions to scientific knowledge in the early stages of career".
